We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What we are looking for   We are looking for a Cyber Security Operations Analyst to join our Security Operations Center team. In this role, you will protect Orange customer systems and environments, working directly with customers and security partners--not only on internal Orange services.What youll be doing   Monitor and correlate security logs and events to identify potential threats. Investigate alerts, eliminate false positives and escalate genuine security incidents. Perform incident identification, triage, tracking, reporting and escalation. Protect Orange customer systems and support the resolution of security incidents. Work and interact directly with customers in a professional and effective manner. Collaborate with Orange Group Cyber Defense, Security Operations Centers and managed security service providers. Monitor cyber security intelligence sources such as CERT and SANS StormCenter. Participate in day and night on-call rotations and shift-based activities. Support security dashboards, assessments and testing activities. Contribute to security procedures, work instructions and continuous improvement initiatives. Prepare periodic and ad-hoc reports for management. Follow Orange security, quality, health and safety policies.   What you need to know/have   University degree in IT, Telecommunications or a related field. Minimum one year of experience in security administration, network administration or a similar role. Mandatory hands-on experience with log onboarding, including collecting, integrating and validating security logs from customer systems. Knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line troubleshooting. Knowledge of security methodologies, processes and technical security solutions. Good understanding of TCP/IP, network analysis and network/security applications. Familiarity with common internet protocols and applications. Knowledge of SIEM and security event management. Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with customers. Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills. Excellent computer skills, including Excel. Availability to work shifts, night shifts, weekends and on-call rotations. Ability to work extended hours when required to resolve active security incidents. Rigor, autonomy, adaptability, initiative and proactivity. Strong teamwork and results-oriented mindset. Whats in it for you Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys Electronic Meal Tickets Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too Professional GSM subscription Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!] Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen
